findings.body: The command test supplies a P1 review finding and an `our default` answer, but never a P0 finding or a must-answer topic sourced only from `agent`. Removing either rejection would leave this test passing, although item 7 requires both to block acceptance. Add command-level cases that verify the decision remains proposed.
findings.title: Not done: P0 and agent-source sign-off test

findings.body: The tests reject a blank or mismatched customer but never try a matching name without a role, accept approval by call, or assert that `confirmed_by` contains the recorder named by `--by`. The successful case checks `reviewed_commit` only. Dropping role validation, rejecting calls, or recording the customer in place of the recorder would leave these tests passing, contrary to item 8.
findings.title: Not done: customer identity and approval test
